description:
Hi everyone! I’m Josh, a Computer Science student based in Zimbabwe. I’m incredibly passionate about leveraging tech for climate action, building accessible UI and open-source AI. Outside of coding/working, you can usually find me farming or travelling the globe.

Why You Should Join My Team?

I believe the best projects come from diverse perspectives. If you want a team that values open communication, ambitious goals, and actually having fun while we build, this is the place for you.
summary: We developed a virtual assistant designed & engineered to generate useful data & information to both teachers and learners. This virtual assistant [TATI AI] is an crucial tool that will assist Earth Scientists & Mathematicians with valuable data i.e raw & processed, so as to create visaualisations to solve challenges experienced at NASA's Earth Sciences faculty/department. It is trained to provide well structured answers and step-by-step instructions enabling users to generate a visualisation on any platform or setting, paired with an educated-experienced human, who knows how to ask the right questions! Tati's knowledge base is broad allowing it to think outside the box. That is to say it can accurately answer questions beyond the scope of Earth Science and also indulge in a conversation.
details: It is a large language model that can operate with and without an internet connection. Any device connected to the Wide or Local Area Network can communicate with this console. It is trained to provide users with essential data and information regarding Earth Sciences. This is a foundational tool is used to create visualizations. It can generate the necessary raw & processed data needed and can translate the data from machine language [low level language] to a language best understood by humans [high level language]. We believe there is no single best tool that can be used for data visualization so we have designed an A.I that speaks to create new platforms and methods of visualisation. It provides step-by-step instructions to humans depending on the challenge, use case, setting and available resources. It can control any website through clicking and loading information hence creating a visualization on the go. The imagination is a very powerful phenomenon that we should harness.
